question: Which activity takes the longest time? ⏱️
explanation: Great job! Sleeping takes many hours, while the others are very quick! 🛏️

question: What is the quickest action? ⚡
explanation: Awesome! Blinking your eyes takes just one second! 👀

question: What do we use to check the time? ⏰
explanation: Super! A clock helps us know what time it is all day! 🕰️

question: What shows us days and months? 📅
explanation: Great job! A calendar shows us all the days, weeks, and months! 🗓️

question: When do we eat breakfast? 🥞
explanation: Awesome! Breakfast is the first yummy meal we eat in the morning! 🥞

question: When do we eat lunch? 🍱
explanation: Super! We eat our tasty lunch in the afternoon! 🍱

question: When do we eat dinner? 🍲
explanation: Great job! Dinner is the last meal we eat at night before bed! 🍲

question: When does the sun rise? 🌄
explanation: Awesome! The bright sun wakes up in the morning to start the day! 🌅

question: When does the sun set? 🌇
explanation: Super! The sun goes down in the evening to let us rest! 🌇

question: When do the stars shine? ✨
explanation: Great job! Stars twinkle in the dark sky at night! ✨

question: What does the short hand on a clock show? ⌚
explanation: Awesome! The short and slow hand tells us the hour! 🕰️
hint: It points to the big numbers.

question: What does the long hand on a clock show? ⌚
explanation: Super! The long hand points to the minutes! ⏳
hint: It moves faster than the hour hand.

question: Which hand moves very fast? 🏃
explanation: Great job! The second hand ticks and moves very fast! ⏱️

question: What numbers are on a clock? 🔢
explanation: Awesome! A clock has numbers from 1 to 12 in a circle! 🕛

question: Both hands are on 12. What time is it? 🕛
explanation: Super! When both hands point straight up, it is twelve o'clock! 🕛

question: Short hand on 3, long hand on 12. Time? 🕒
explanation: Great job! The short hand tells the hour, so it is three o'clock! 🕒

question: How many minutes in one hour? ⏳
explanation: Awesome! One full hour is made of sixty minutes! ⏳

question: How many seconds in one minute? ⏱️
explanation: Super! Just like an hour, a minute has sixty seconds! ⏱️

question: How much time to brush your teeth? 🪥
explanation: Great job! Brushing takes a few minutes to make teeth sparkle! 🪥
hint: Not too fast, not too slow.

question: How long does a plant take to grow? 🌱
explanation: Awesome! Plants need many months of sunshine and water to grow big! 🌱
hint: It takes a very long time.

question: How long does it take to clap once? 👏
explanation: Super! Clapping your hands is super quick, just one second! 👏

question: How long to build a big house? 🏠
explanation: Great job! A house is huge and takes many months to build safely! 🏠

question: How long does milk take to boil? 🥛
explanation: Awesome! Milk boils quickly on the stove in a few minutes! 🥛

question: How long to tie your shoelaces? 👟
explanation: Super! Tying shoelaces is a quick job that takes a few seconds! 👟
hint: It is a fast loop and pull.

question: How long to read a thick book? 📚
explanation: Great job! A big book has many pages, so it takes a few days! 📚
hint: You read a little every night.

question: How long to knit a warm sweater? 🧶
explanation: Awesome! Grandma takes many days to carefully knit a cozy sweater! 🧶

question: How many days are in a week? 🗓️
explanation: Super! A week has seven wonderful days! 🗓️

question: How many months are in a year? 📅
explanation: Great job! There are twelve months in one whole year! 📅

question: Which day comes after Monday? 📅
explanation: Awesome! Tuesday comes right after Monday in the week! 📅

question: Which day comes before Sunday? 📅
explanation: Super! Saturday comes just before Sunday! 📅
hint: The first day of the weekend.

question: Which is the first month? 🎆
explanation: Great job! A new year always begins with January! 🎆

question: Which is the last month? 🎄
explanation: Awesome! December is the final month before a new year starts! 🎄

question: Which month has the shortest days? 📅
explanation: Super! February is a special month with only 28 or 29 days! 📅

question: When do we go to school? 🎒
explanation: Great job! We wake up early and go to school in the morning! 🎒

question: When do we play with friends? 🏏
explanation: Awesome! Evening is the best time to run and play outside! 🏏

question: Which days are the weekend? 🎉
explanation: Super! Saturday and Sunday are fun weekend days with no school! 🎉

question: How long for hair to grow long? 💇‍♀️
explanation: Great job! Hair grows very slowly over many months! 💇‍♀️

question: How often does your birthday come? 🎂
explanation: Awesome! You celebrate your fun birthday once every year! 🎂
hint: You blow out candles once a year.

question: How many minutes in half an hour? ⏳
explanation: Super! Half of sixty is thirty, so half an hour is 30 minutes! ⏳

question: How long for seasons to change? 🍂
explanation: Great job! It takes months for summer to turn into winter! 🍂
hint: It is a slow weather change.

question: What is true about time? ⏱️
explanation: Awesome! Time always keeps moving forward and never stops! ⏱️

question: How long to wash your hands? 🧼
explanation: Super! Washing hands with soap takes just a few seconds! 🧼

question: How long to eat an apple? 🍎
explanation: Great job! Chewing a yummy apple takes a few healthy minutes! 🍎

question: How long for a baby to walk? 👶
explanation: Awesome! Babies grow and learn to walk over many months! 👶

question: How long to bake a cake? 🎂
explanation: Super! Baking a tasty cake in the oven takes about an hour! 🎂
hint: You wait while it smells good.

question: When do you return from school? 🏠
explanation: Great job! After learning, you come back home in the afternoon! 🏠

question: Seven days together make one what? 📅
explanation: Awesome! Monday to Sunday makes one full week! 🗓️

question: Twelve months together make one what? 🎆
explanation: Super! January to December makes one full year! 🎆
hint: When you turn a year older.

question: How does the short hand move? 🐢
explanation: Great job! The short hour hand moves very slowly like a turtle! 🐢
hint: It takes an hour to move one number.

question: How does the long hand move? 🐇
explanation: Awesome! The long minute hand moves faster than the hour hand! 🐇
hint: It goes around in one hour.
